scope: Fold 1 held-out NLR values missing in the frozen four-way comparison, 45 of 200 patients

definition.accepted_representations: one JSON number, or one documented categorical/threshold string when the numeric measurement is unavailable
definition.description: The ratio of the absolute neutrophil count to the absolute lymphocyte count, used as a marker of systemic inflammation.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the explicitly reported neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) from laboratory results. If the ratio is not explicitly provided but absolute neutrophil and lymphocyte counts are available in the CBC differential, the value is the quotient of absolute neutrophils divided by absolute lymphocytes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if neither the NLR nor both necessary components (absolute neutrophils and absolute lymphocytes) are documented.
definition.name: neutrophil_to_lymphocyte_ratio

prompt_scalar_rule: From a composite such as 147/93, use only a component explicitly named by the feature; if the definition requests multiple components, return null rather than a ratio string or aggregate.
prompt_rule_interpretation: Potential ambiguity with the NLR definition, which explicitly permits calculating ANC/ALC. This is a plausible contributor, not an experimentally demonstrated cause.
classification_limits: Paired counts establish a documented calculation opportunity, not the uniquely correct baseline/latest value or agreement with the latent oracle. Negative values create a source-validity problem; exact reasons for accepted nulls were not recorded. Missing source evidence and empty source records are not established extractor errors.
